title: RLBot agent
description: Configuration for an RLBot bot or script.

settings.description: Settings for the bot or script.

agent_id.description: The unique ID the bot or script uses to connect to RLBot. Use the format 'author/name' or 'author/name/version'.

loadout_file.description: Path to the bot's loadout file, relative to this config file. Ignored for scripts.

root_dir.description: Working directory for the launch command. Relative paths start at the directory that contains this config file.

run_command.description: Command to start the bot or script on Windows. Omit it or use an empty string to disable automatic launch on Windows.

run_command_linux.description: Command to start the bot or script on Linux. When RLBot core reads a TOML config, it falls back to running the Windows command with Wine if this command is empty or missing. The GUI does not use this fallback.

logo_file.description: Path to the logo image, relative to root_dir.

hivemind.description: If true, one process controls the bot's cars on the same team. Ignored for scripts.

environment.description: Environment variables for the process RLBot starts. Common values do not expand variable references. Use the windows or linux table to add or override values for that platform. The GUI appends to the current path list if the value starts with the path separator. It prepends if the value ends with the separator. Use ';' on Windows and ':' on Linux. RLBot sets RLBOT_AGENT_ID and RLBOT_SERVER_PORT itself.

details.description: Optional details that will appear in RLBot's GUI

fun_fact.description: A fun fact about the bot/script

source_link.description: A link to the source code of the bot/script

language.description: The language the bot/script is written in

tags.description: A list of tags that describe the bot/script

platformEnvironment.description: String values for this platform. RLBot expands $VAR, ${VAR}, and %VAR% references from the environment of the GUI or core. Unknown references stay unchanged.
